				Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.IrSiguiente()
			EndDo
		
			ThisForm.oTbxRetencionesIIBB.Value = ThisForm.oViewImputacionClientes.Sumar("RetIIBB",".T.")
			Thisform.oTbxTotalRetIIBB.Value	   = ThisForm.oViewImputacionClientes.Sumar("RetIIBB",".T.")
			ThisForm.oTbxTotal.Value 	 	   = ThisForm.oViewImputacionClientes.Sumar("Total",".T.")
			ThisForm.oTbxDiferencia.Value 	   = ThisForm.oViewImputacionClientes.Sumar("Pendiente",".T.")	
		Endif
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE inicializarcontroles
		Local mmpp
		
		Thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		Thisform.oTbxGastosProrrateo.Value = 0
		ThisForm.oTbxRetencionesProrrateo.Value = 0
		ThisForm.oTbxRetencionesIIBB.Value = 0
		ThisForm.oTbxRetencionesGan.Value = 0
		Thisform.oTbxTotalACObraSocial.Value = 0
		Thisform.oTbxTotalPendiente.Value = 0
		Thisform.oTbxToltalCobrado.Value = 0
		Thisform.oTbxGastosRet.Value = 0
		Thisform.oTbxTotal.Value = 0
		Thisform.oTbxImpNC.Value = 0
		Thisform.oTbxImpND.Value = 0
		ThisForm.oTbxDiferencia.Value = 0
		ThisForm.oTbxDiasPosteriorAPresentacion.Value = 0
		
		Thisform.oTbxId_Cliente.Value ="" 
		Thisform.oTbxNroLiquidacion.Value = "    -        "
		Thisform.oTbxFecha.Value = ctod("  /  /    ")
		
		If Thisform.oCstGrabarProrrateo.ProcesoDeControl()
		
			If Type("thisform.oFormObrasSocialesDetalle") <> "O"			 
			   Thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFormObrasSocialesDetalle","Tg_FormObrasSocialesDetalle")
			Endif
		
			If Thisform.oTblClientes.Buscar(Thisform.Id_Cliente, .F., "Clave")
				ThisForm.RazonSocial.Value  = Thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("Razon_Social")	
				ThisForm.oTbxDiasPosteriorAPresentacion.Value  = Thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("DiasPosterioresPresentacion")	
				ThisForm.Tg_clientes1.Value = Thisform.Id_Cliente
			Endif 
		
			For mmpp=1 to thisform.tg_grid1.ColumnCount
				thisform.tg_Grid1.Columns(mmpp).DynamicBackColor="Iif(Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer('Titulo'), rgb(113,198,249), rgb(255,255,255))"
			Next
		
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column10.DynamicCurrentControl="iif(!Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer('Titulo'),'oBntAjustes','Text1')"	
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column13.DynamicCurrentControl="iif(!Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer('Titulo'),'oChkSeleccionado','Text1')"	
		
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column1.ReadOnly=.T.
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column2.ReadOnly=.T.
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column3.ReadOnly=.T.
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column4.ReadOnly=.T.
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column5.ReadOnly=.T.
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column6.ReadOnly=.T.
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column7.ReadOnly=.F.
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column8.ReadOnly=.F.
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column9.ReadOnly=.T.
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column10.ReadOnly=.F.
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column11.ReadOnly=.T.
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column12.ReadOnly=.T.
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column13.ReadOnly=.F.
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column15.ReadOnly=.F.
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column16.ReadOnly=.F.
		
			Thisform.RefrescarConsulta()
		Else
			Thisform.tg_grid1.Enabled = .F.
			Thisform.oCmdDistribuir.Enabled = .F.
			ThisForm.oCmdValidar.Enabled = .F.
			ThisForm.oTbxGastosProrrateo.Enabled = .F.
			ThisForm.oTbxRetencionesProrrateo.Enabled = .F.
			ThisForm.oTbxRetencionesIIBB.Enabled = .F.
			ThisForm.oTbxRetencionesGan.Enabled = .F.
		Endif
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		lParameters cId_Cliente, lSuma, dFechaCobranza
		Dodefault()
		
		ThisForm.AddObject("oTblParametros"			,"Tg_tabla","Parametros")	
		ThisForm.AddObject("oTblClientes"			,"Tg_tabla","Clientes"	, "CLAVE")	
		
		ThisForm.AddObject("oViewImputacionClientes","Tg_ViewImputacionClientes")
		
		Thisform.AddObject("oCstGrabarProrrateo" , "tg_prorrateoobrassociales")
		
		Thisform.Id_Cliente = cId_Cliente
		Thisform.Suma		= lSuma
		*** Chiara 24/12/2020
		IF thisForm.oTblClientes.Buscar(cId_cliente, .f., "Clave")
			IF thisForm.oTblClientes.Leer("MarcaLiquidacionesVencidas")
				thisForm.fecha_cobranzaoriginal = dFechaCobranza
		
				IF !EMPTY(thisForm.oTblClientes.Leer("CantDiasLiquidacion")) OR thisForm.oTblClientes.Leer("CantDiasLiquidacion") > 0
					thisForm.fecha_cobranza = dFechaCobranza - thisForm.oTblClientes.Leer("CantDiasLiquidacion")
				ELSE 
					thisForm.fecha_cobranza = dFechaCobranza - thisForm.oTblParametros.Leer("CantDiasLiquidacion")
				ENDIF 
				
				thisForm.marcaLiquidaciones = .T.
			ELSE 
				thisForm.btnConfigDias.Visible = .F.
				thisForm.tg_3dshape3.Visible = .F.
				thisForm.tg_label12.Visible = .F.
				thisForm.marcaLiquidaciones = .F.
			ENDIF 	
		ENDIF 
		*** Chiara 24/12/2020
		
		ThisForm.InicializarControles()
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

			Else
				Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)			
			Endif	
			thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()
		Endif
	ENDPROC

		*** Chiara 24/12/2020 
		thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConfiguracionDias","Tg_ConfigDiasCobranza",thisForm.tg_clientes1.Value)				
		
		thisform.oFrmConfiguracionDias.Show()

	PROCEDURE validar
		Local lEsValido, cMensajeError, nRenglon, vDatos
		Dimension vDatos[1,2]
		
		lEsValido = .T.
		cMensajeError = "Se detectaron los siguientes errores:"
		
		Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.IrPrimero()
		DO WHILE !Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.EsEof()
			
			If !Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Titulo")
				If Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Cerrar")
					If Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Pendiente") <> (Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Total") + Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("ImpAjusteNC") - Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("ImpAjusteND"))
						lEsValido = .F.
						cMensajeError = cMensajeError + CHR(13) + "   O.S.: " + Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Id_ClienteImputacion") + " Cmp Nro.: " + Str(Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),10) + " la suma de los importes no es igual al pendiente." 
					Endif
				Endif
					
				If !Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Cerrar")
					If Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Pendiente") < (Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Total") + Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("ImpAjusteNC") - Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("ImpAjusteND"))
						lEsValido = .F.
					    cMensajeError = cMensajeError + CHR(13) + "   O.S.: " + Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Id_ClienteImputacion") + " Cmp Nro.: " + Str(Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),10) + " la suma de los importes es mayor al importe pendiente." 
					Endif
				Endif
			Endif	
				
			Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.IrSiguiente()
		ENDDO
		
		If (Thisform.oTbxGastosProrrateo.Value + ThisForm.oTbxRetencionesProrrateo.Value) <> Thisform.oTbxGastosRet.Value
			lEsValido = .F.
			cMensajeError = cMensajeError + CHR(13) + "   El monto de la columna Gastos / Retenciones Otras de la grilla no es igual al total de Gastos / Retenciones Otras indicado."
		Endif
		
		If (ThisForm.oTbxRetencionesIIBB.Value) <> Thisform.oTbxTotalRetIIBB.Value
			lEsValido = .F.
			cMensajeError = cMensajeError + CHR(13) + "   El monto de la columna Ret. IIBB de la grilla no es igual al total de Ret. IIBB indicado."
		Endif
		
		If (ThisForm.oTbxRetencionesGan.Value) <> Thisform.oTbxTotalRetGan.Value
			lEsValido = .F.
			cMensajeError = cMensajeError + CHR(13) + "   El monto de la columna Ret. Gan de la grilla no es igual al total de Ret. Gan indicado."
		Endif
		
		IF !lEsValido
			=fMensAceptar(cMensajeError)
		ENDIF
		
		If Thisform.oTblClientes.Buscar(Thisform.Id_Cliente, .F., "Clave")
			=fGrabar(@vDatos, "DiasPosterioresPresentacion", ThisForm.oTbxDiasPosteriorAPresentacion.Value)
			Thisform.oTblClientes.Modificar(@vDatos, .F., .t.)
		Endif
		
		RETURN lEsValido
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton3.Click
		Local cFiltro, lPrimero
		
		lPrimero = .T.
		cFiltro = ""
		
		
		Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Desfiltrar()
		
		
		IF !Empty(Thisform.oTbxId_Cliente.Value)
			cFiltro = Thisform.AgregarFiltro(cFiltro, lPrimero, "Id_ClienteImputacion = '" + Thisform.oTbxId_Cliente.Value + "'")
			lPrimero = .F.
		ENDIF
		
		
		IF !Empty(Thisform.oTbxNroLiquidacion.Value) And Thisform.oTbxNroLiquidacion.Value <> "    -        "
			cFiltro =  Thisform.AgregarFiltro(cFiltro, lPrimero, "Nro_Externo = '" + Thisform.oTbxNroLiquidacion.Value + "'")
			lPrimero = .F.
		ENDIF
		
		
		IF !Empty(Thisform.oTbxFecha.Value)
			cFiltro =  Thisform.AgregarFiltro(cFiltro, lPrimero, "Fecha = CTOD('" + DTOC(Thisform.oTbxFecha.Value) + "')")
			lPrimero = .F.
		ENDIF
		
		
		If !Empty(cFiltro)
			Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Filtrar(cFiltro)
			ThisForm.tg_grid1.Refresh()
		Endif
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE actualizarvaloresalret
		lParameters nValor, lRetOtros, lRetIIBB, lRetGan
		
		Local vGrabacion, nTotal
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		nTotal = Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Cobrado")
		
		Do Case
			case lRetOtros
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"GastosRet" , nValor)
				nTotal = nTotal + Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("RetIIBB") + Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("RetGan")
			Case lRetIIBB
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"RetIIBB" , nValor)
				nTotal = nTotal + Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("GastosRet") + Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("RetGan")
			Case lRetGan
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"RetGan" , nValor)
				nTotal = nTotal + Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("GastosRet") + Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("RetIIBB")
		EndCase 
		
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Total" 	 , nTotal + nValor)
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Diferencia", Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Pendiente") - (nTotal + nValor) - Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("ImpAjusteNC") + Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("ImpAjusteND"))
		Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Modificar(@vGrabacion, .F., .T.)
		
		ThisForm.oTbxGastosRet.Value  = ThisForm.oViewImputacionClientes.Sumar("GastosRet",".T.")
		ThisForm.oTbxTotalRetIIBB.Value  = ThisForm.oViewImputacionClientes.Sumar("RetIIBB",".T.")
		ThisForm.oTbxTotalRetGan.Value  = ThisForm.oViewImputacionClientes.Sumar("RetGan",".T.")
		ThisForm.oTbxTotal.Value 	  = ThisForm.oViewImputacionClientes.Sumar("Total",".T.")
		ThisForm.oTbxDiferencia.Value = ThisForm.oViewImputacionClientes.Sumar("Pendiente",".T.")
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE agregarfiltro
		lParameters cFiltro, lPrimero, cNuevoFiltro
		
		IF !lPrimero
			cFiltro = cFiltro + " AND "
		ENDIF
		RETURN cFiltro + cNuevoFiltro
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE buscarerrorenliquidaciones
		Local vDatos, lError
		Dimension vDatos[1,2]
		
		Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.IrPrimero()
		Do While !Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.EsEof()
		
			lError = .f.
			
			If !Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Titulo")
				If (Empty(Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("fecha_hastaliquidacionsifaco")))
					lError = .t.
				Endif
		
				If Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("fecha") > (Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("fecha_hastaliquidacionsifaco") + ThisForm.oTbxDiasPosteriorAPresentacion.Value)
					lError = .t.
				Endif
		
				=fGrabar(@vDatos, "Error", lError)
				Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Modificar(@vDatos, .f., .t.)
			Endif
			
			Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.IrSiguiente()
		EndDo
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE calculardiferenciadias
		LPARAMETERS dFecha,nCantDias,lTitulo
		
		IF nCantDias > 0 AND !lTitulo
			IF dFecha < thisForm.Fecha_cobranza - nCantDias
				RETURN RGB(245,233,157)
			ELSE 
				RETURN RGB(255,255,255)
			ENDIF 
		ELSE
			IF lTitulo
				RETURN RGB(113,198,249)
			ELSE
				RETURN RGB(255,255,255)
			ENDIF 
		ENDIF 
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE calcularprorrateogastos
		Local vGrabacion, nImporte, nTotalComprobante, nTotal
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		nImporte = 0
		nTotalComprobante = 0
		nTotal = 0
		
		If Thisform.oTbxToltalCobrado.Value > 0
		
			nTotalComprobante = ThisForm.oViewImputacionClientes.Sumar("TotalCmp", "Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer('Cobrado') > 0")
			
			Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.IrPrimero()
			Do While !Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.EsEof()
		
				If Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Cobrado") > 0
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Porcentaje" , Round((Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("TotalCmp") * 100) / nTotalComprobante,2))
					Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Modificar(@vGrabacion, .F., .T.)
				Endif
		
				Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.IrSiguiente()
			EndDo
		
		
			Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.IrPrimero()
			Do While !Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.EsEof()
		
				If Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Porcentaje") > 0
					nImporte = Round(((Thisform.oTbxGastosProrrateo.Value + ThisForm.oTbxRetencionesProrrateo.Value) * Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Porcentaje")) / 100,2)
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"GastosRet" , nImporte)
					nTotal = Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Cobrado") + nImporte + Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("RetIIBB") + Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("RetGAN")
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Total" 	 , nTotal)
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Diferencia", Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Pendiente") - nTotal - Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("ImpAjusteNC") + Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("ImpAjusteND"))
					Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Modificar(@vGrabacion, .F., .T.)
				Endif
		
				Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.IrSiguiente()
			EndDo
		
			ThisForm.oTbxGastosRet.Value = ThisForm.oViewImputacionClientes.Sumar("GastosRet",".T.")
			ThisForm.oTbxTotal.Value 	 = ThisForm.oViewImputacionClientes.Sumar("Total",".T.")
			ThisForm.oTbxDiferencia.Value = ThisForm.oViewImputacionClientes.Sumar("Pendiente",".T.")	
		Endif
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE calcularprorrateoretgan
		Local vGrabacion, nImporte, nTotalComprobante, nTotal
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		nImporte = 0
		nTotalComprobante = 0
		nTotal = 0
		
		If Thisform.oTbxToltalCobrado.Value > 0
		
			nTotalComprobante = ThisForm.oViewImputacionClientes.Sumar("TotalCmp", "Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer('Cobrado') > 0")
			
			Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.IrPrimero()
			Do While !Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.EsEof()
		
				If Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Cobrado") > 0
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"PorcentajeGAN" , Round((Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("TotalCmp") * 100) / nTotalComprobante,2))
				Else
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"PorcentajeGAN" , 0)
				Endif
				Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Modificar(@vGrabacion, .F., .T.)
		
				Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.IrSiguiente()
			EndDo
		
		
			Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.IrPrimero()
			Do While !Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.EsEof()
		
				If Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("PorcentajeGAN") > 0
					nImporte = Round((Thisform.oTbxRetencionesGan.Value * Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("PorcentajeGAN")) / 100,2)
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"RetGAN" 	 , nImporte)
					nTotal = Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Cobrado") + nImporte + Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("RetIIBB") + Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("GastosRet")
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Total" 	 , nTotal)
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Diferencia", Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Pendiente") - nTotal - Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("ImpAjusteNC") + Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("ImpAjusteND"))
					Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Modificar(@vGrabacion, .F., .T.)
				Endif
		
				Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.IrSiguiente()
			EndDo
		
			ThisForm.oTbxRetencionesGan.Value = ThisForm.oViewImputacionClientes.Sumar("RetGan",".T.")
			Thisform.oTbxTotalRetGan.Value	  = ThisForm.oViewImputacionClientes.Sumar("RetGan",".T.")
			ThisForm.oTbxTotal.Value 	 	  = ThisForm.oViewImputacionClientes.Sumar("Total",".T.")
			ThisForm.oTbxDiferencia.Value 	  = ThisForm.oViewImputacionClientes.Sumar("Pendiente",".T.")	
		Endif
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE calcularprorrateoretiibb
		Local vGrabacion, nImporte, nTotalComprobante, nTotal
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		nImporte = 0
		nTotalComprobante = 0
		nTotal = 0
		
		If Thisform.oTbxToltalCobrado.Value > 0
		
			nTotalComprobante = ThisForm.oViewImputacionClientes.Sumar("TotalCmp", "Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer('Cobrado') > 0")
			
			Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.IrPrimero()
			Do While !Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.EsEof()
		
				If Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Cobrado") > 0
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"PorcentajeIIBB" , Round((Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("TotalCmp") * 100) / nTotalComprobante,2))
				Else
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"PorcentajeIIBB" , 0)
				Endif
				Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Modificar(@vGrabacion, .F., .T.)
		
				Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.IrSiguiente()
			EndDo
		
		
			Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.IrPrimero()
			Do While !Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.EsEof()
		
				If Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("PorcentajeIIBB") > 0
					nImporte = Round((Thisform.oTbxRetencionesIIBB.Value * Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("PorcentajeIIBB")) / 100,2)
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"RetIIBB" 	 , nImporte)
					nTotal = Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Cobrado") + nImporte + Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("RetGAN") + Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("GastosRet")
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Total" 	 , nTotal)
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Diferencia", Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Pendiente") - nTotal - Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("ImpAjusteNC") + Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("ImpAjusteND"))
					Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Modificar(@vGrabacion, .F., .T.)
				Endif
		
				Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.IrSiguiente()
			EndDo
		
			ThisForm.oTbxRetencionesIIBB.Value = ThisForm.oViewImputacionClientes.Sumar("RetIIBB",".T.")
			Thisform.oTbxTotalRetIIBB.Value	   = ThisForm.oViewImputacionClientes.Sumar("RetIIBB",".T.")
			ThisForm.oTbxTotal.Value 	 	   = ThisForm.oViewImputacionClientes.Sumar("Total",".T.")
			ThisForm.oTbxDiferencia.Value 	   = ThisForm.oViewImputacionClientes.Sumar("Pendiente",".T.")	
		Endif
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE validar
		Local lEsValido, cMensajeError, nRenglon, vDatos
		Dimension vDatos[1,2]
		
		lEsValido = .T.
		cMensajeError = "Se detectaron los siguientes errores:"
		
		Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.IrPrimero()
		DO WHILE !Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.EsEof()
			
			If !Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Titulo")
				If Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Cerrar")
					If Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Pendiente") <> (Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Total") + Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("ImpAjusteNC") - Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("ImpAjusteND"))
						lEsValido = .F.
						cMensajeError = cMensajeError + CHR(13) + "   O.S.: " + Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Id_ClienteImputacion") + " Cmp Nro.: " + Str(Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),10) + " la suma de los importes no es igual al pendiente." 
					Endif
				Endif
					
				If !Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Cerrar")
					If Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Pendiente") < (Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Total") + Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("ImpAjusteNC") - Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("ImpAjusteND"))
						lEsValido = .F.
					    cMensajeError = cMensajeError + CHR(13) + "   O.S.: " + Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Id_ClienteImputacion") + " Cmp Nro.: " + Str(Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),10) + " la suma de los importes es mayor al importe pendiente." 
					Endif
				Endif
			Endif	
				
			Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.IrSiguiente()
		ENDDO
		
		If (Thisform.oTbxGastosProrrateo.Value + ThisForm.oTbxRetencionesProrrateo.Value) <> Thisform.oTbxGastosRet.Value
			lEsValido = .F.
			cMensajeError = cMensajeError + CHR(13) + "   El monto de la columna Gastos / Retenciones Otras de la grilla no es igual al total de Gastos / Retenciones Otras indicado."
		Endif
		
		If (ThisForm.oTbxRetencionesIIBB.Value) <> Thisform.oTbxTotalRetIIBB.Value
			lEsValido = .F.
			cMensajeError = cMensajeError + CHR(13) + "   El monto de la columna Ret. IIBB de la grilla no es igual al total de Ret. IIBB indicado."
		Endif
		
		If (ThisForm.oTbxRetencionesGan.Value) <> Thisform.oTbxTotalRetGan.Value
			lEsValido = .F.
			cMensajeError = cMensajeError + CHR(13) + "   El monto de la columna Ret. Gan de la grilla no es igual al total de Ret. Gan indicado."
		Endif
		
		IF !lEsValido
			=fMensAceptar(cMensajeError)
		ENDIF
		
		If Thisform.oTblClientes.Buscar(Thisform.Id_Cliente, .F., "Clave")
			=fGrabar(@vDatos, "DiasPosterioresPresentacion", ThisForm.oTbxDiasPosteriorAPresentacion.Value)
			Thisform.oTblClientes.Modificar(@vDatos, .F., .t.)
		Endif
		
		RETURN lEsValido
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton3.Click
		Local cFiltro, lPrimero
		
		lPrimero = .T.
		cFiltro = ""
		
		
		Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Desfiltrar()
		
		
		IF !Empty(Thisform.oTbxId_Cliente.Value)
			cFiltro = Thisform.AgregarFiltro(cFiltro, lPrimero, "Id_ClienteImputacion = '" + Thisform.oTbxId_Cliente.Value + "'")
			lPrimero = .F.
		ENDIF
		
		
		IF !Empty(Thisform.oTbxNroLiquidacion.Value) And Thisform.oTbxNroLiquidacion.Value <> "    -        "
			cFiltro =  Thisform.AgregarFiltro(cFiltro, lPrimero, "Nro_Externo = '" + Thisform.oTbxNroLiquidacion.Value + "'")
			lPrimero = .F.
		ENDIF
		
		
		IF !Empty(Thisform.oTbxFecha.Value)
			cFiltro =  Thisform.AgregarFiltro(cFiltro, lPrimero, "Fecha = CTOD('" + DTOC(Thisform.oTbxFecha.Value) + "')")
			lPrimero = .F.
		ENDIF
		
		
		If !Empty(cFiltro)
			Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Filtrar(cFiltro)
			ThisForm.tg_grid1.Refresh()
		Endif
		
	ENDPROC

		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Cobrado"   , This.Value)
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Diferencia", Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Pendiente") - (This.Value + Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("GastosRet") + Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("RetIIBB") + Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("RetGAN")) - Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("ImpAjusteNC") + Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("ImpAjusteND"))
		Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Modificar(@vGrabacion, .F., .T.)
		
		ThisForm.oTbxToltalCobrado.Value = ThisForm.oViewImputacionClientes.Sumar("Cobrado",".T.")
		ThisForm.oTbxTotal.Value 		  = ThisForm.oViewImputacionClientes.Sumar("Total",".T.")
		ThisForm.oTbxDiferencia.Value 	  = ThisForm.oViewImputacionClientes.Sumar("Pendiente",".T.")
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column8.Text1.SetFocus
		thisform.actualizarValoresAlRet(this.value,.t.,.f.,.f.)
		
		*!*	Local vGrabacion
		*!*	Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		*!*	=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Total" 	 , Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Cobrado") + This.Value)
		*!*	=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"GastosRet" , This.Value)
		*!*	=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Diferencia", Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Pendiente") - (Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Cobrado") + This.Value) - Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("ImpAjusteNC") + Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("ImpAjusteND"))
		*!*	Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Modificar(@vGrabacion, .F., .T.)
		
		*!*	ThisForm.oTbxGastosRet.Value  = ThisForm.oViewImputacionClientes.Sumar("GastosRet",".T.")
		*!*	ThisForm.oTbxTotal.Value 	  = ThisForm.oViewImputacionClientes.Sumar("Total",".T.")
		*!*	ThisForm.oTbxDiferencia.Value = ThisForm.oViewImputacionClientes.Sumar("Pendiente",".T.")
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column8.Text1.Valid
		thisform.actualizarValoresAlRet(this.value,.t.,.f.,.f.)
		
		*!*	Local vGrabacion
		*!*	Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		*!*	=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Total" 	 , Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Cobrado") + This.Value)
		*!*	=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"GastosRet" , This.Value)
		*!*	=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Diferencia", Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Pendiente") - (Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("Cobrado") + This.Value) - Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("ImpAjusteNC") + Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Leer("ImpAjusteND"))
		*!*	Thisform.oViewImputacionClientes.Modificar(@vGrabacion, .F., .T.)
		
		*!*	ThisForm.oTbxGastosRet.Value  = ThisForm.oViewImputacionClientes.Sumar("GastosRet",".T.")
		*!*	ThisForm.oTbxTotal.Value 	  = ThisForm.oViewImputacionClientes.Sumar("Total",".T.")
		*!*	ThisForm.oTbxDiferencia.Value = ThisForm.oViewImputacionClientes.Sumar("Pendiente",".T.")
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_optiongroup1.InteractiveChange
		**Chiara 14/01/2019
		IF this.Value = 2
			thisForm.oViewImputacionClientes.FijarTag("Nombre")
		ELSE 
			thisForm.oViewImputacionClientes.FijarTag("Clave")
		ENDIF 
		**Chiara 14/01/2019
		
		thisForm.refrescarGrilla()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE abrirformimputacion
		IF Thisform.oTblVnt_Docu.Buscar(Thisform.Id_Comproba)
			nCopias = Thisform.oTblVnt_Docu.Leer("Copias")
		ENDIF 
		
		thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmImputarCliente","TG_Imputacion",Thisform.Id_Cliente,Thisform.Id_sucursal,Thisform.Id_Sistema,Thisform.ID_comproba,Thisform.Nro_Referencia,nCopias,thisform.Id_grupoSucur,.T.)
		thisform.oFrmImputarCliente.WindowType = 1
		
		Thisform.IngresoImputacion = .T.
		Thisform.Imputado = .T.
		
		thisform.oFrmImputarCliente.Show()
		
		Thisform.RefrescarConsulta(Thisform.Id_Cliente,Thisform.Suma,Thisform.Fecha,Thisform.Id_Comproba,,0,0,0,Thisform.id_gruposucur)
		Thisform.RefrescarConsultacredito(Thisform.Id_Cliente,!Thisform.Suma,Thisform.id_gruposucur)
		
		Thisform.Tg_CmdActualizar.Enabled = .T.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE calcularimporteparcialpagar
		LOCAL vDatos, nImportePago, lRetorna
		DIMENSION vDatos[1,2]
		
		nImportePago = 0
		
		IF thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("PorcAPagar") <> 0
			nImportePago = ROUND((thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("Importe") * thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("PorcAPagar")) / 100, 2)
			
			=fGrabar(@vDatos, "Imp_Pendiente", nImportePago)
			=fGrabar(@vDatos, "lSeleccion"	 , .t.)
			thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Modificar(@vDatos, .f. ,.t.)
		ENDIF
		
		
		lRetorna = thisform.ValidarImportes(.f.)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE completarvector
		local nImporte_Parcial, mmpp, vRetenciones, vImportes,lResul
		nImporte_Parcial= 0
		mmpp= 1
		
		*!*	Dimension thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,3]
		
		*!*	thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,1]= 0
		*!*	thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,2]= 0
		*!*	thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,3]= 0
		
		thisform.oViewComPenClientes.IrPrimero
		
		if thisform.ValidarImportes(.t.)
		
		   Do while !thisform.oViewComPenClientes.EsEof()
		      if thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("lSeleccion")
		         if thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("Imp_Pendiente") > 0
		           
			    	&& Modificacion para que convierta el importe aplicado a cada comprobante a la moneda base (pesos) para que sobre esta calcule las retenciones    
			    	           			   	
		*!*	            thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,1]=Round(thisform.oConvMonUniversal.ConvtotalComprobante(thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.,thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("id_monedaPrincipal"),thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,1],thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("Id_mon_impresion")),2) && Total Grabado
		*!*	            thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,2]=Round(thisform.oConvMonUniversal.ConvtotalComprobante(thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.,thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("id_monedaPrincipal"),thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,2],thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("Id_mon_impresion")),2)  && Total Iva
		*!*		       	thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,3]=Round(thisform.oConvMonUniversal.ConvtotalComprobante(thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.,thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("id_monedaPrincipal"),thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,3],thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("Id_mon_impresion")),2)  && Total no gravado
		            *thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,4]=thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,1]+thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,2]+thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,3]                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          && Total Neto              
		                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 && Total Neto              
		
		            Dimension thisform.Vec_CompImputacion[mmpp,15]
		            thisform.Vec_CompImputacion[mmpp,1]= thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("Id_Sucursal")
		            thisform.Vec_CompImputacion[mmpp,2]= thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("Id_Sistema")
		            thisform.Vec_CompImputacion[mmpp,3]= thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("Id_Comproba")
		            thisform.Vec_CompImputacion[mmpp,4]= thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("Nro_Referencia")
		            thisform.Vec_CompImputacion[mmpp,5]= thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("lSeleccion")  && Total Grabado
		            thisform.Vec_CompImputacion[mmpp,6]= thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("Fecha_Vto")
		*!*	            thisform.Vec_CompImputacion[mmpp,6]= thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,2]  && Total Iva 
		*!*	            thisform.Vec_CompImputacion[mmpp,7]= thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,3]  && Total no gravado
		            thisform.Vec_CompImputacion[mmpp,8]= thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("Imp_Pendiente") && Pendiente
		            thisform.Vec_CompImputacion[mmpp,9]= thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("Importe")       && Pendiente Original
		            thisform.Vec_CompImputacion[mmpp,10]= thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("Nro_Externo") 
		            thisform.Vec_CompImputacion[mmpp,11]= thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("Fecha")        && Fecha Comprobante
		            thisform.Vec_CompImputacion[mmpp,12] = thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("Suma")        && Comprobante Suma o Resta
		            thisform.Vec_CompImputacion[mmpp,15] = thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("Id_Sucursal")+thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("Id_Sistema")+thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("Id_Comproba")+STR(thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),10)
		
		            mmpp= mmpp+1
		
		         endif   
		      endif
		   
		      thisform.oViewComPenClientes.IrSiguiente
		   Enddo
		   
		*!*	   if (thisform.GravadoAntMonedaPrincipal+thisform.IvaAntMonedaPrincipal ) > 0
		*!*	      Dimension thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,4]
		*!*	      thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,1]= thisform.GravadoAntMonedaPrincipal
		*!*	      thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,2]= thisform.IvaAntMonedaPrincipal
		*!*	      thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,3]= 0
		*!*	      thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,4]= thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,1]+thisform.Vec_Importe[mmpp,2]
		*!*	   endif
		*!*	   
		*!*	   Dimension vImportes[1,4]
		*!*	   
		*!*	   vImportes[1,1] = 0
		*!*	   vImportes[1,2] = 0
		*!*	   vImportes[1,3] = 0
		*!*	   vImportes[1,4] = 0
		*!*	   
		*!*	   FOR I=1 TO ALEN(thisform.Vec_Importe,1)
		*!*	   	  vImportes[1,1] = vImportes[1,1] +  thisform.Vec_Importe[i,1]
		*!*	  	  vImportes[1,2] = vImportes[1,2] +  thisform.Vec_Importe[i,2]
		*!*	   	  vImportes[1,3] = vImportes[1,3] +  thisform.Vec_Importe[i,3]
		*!*	   	  vImportes[1,4] = vImportes[1,4] +  thisform.Vec_Importe[i,4]
		*!*	   	  
		*!*	   NEXT
		      
		   thisform.Tg_CmdAceptar.enabled=   .t.
		ELSE 
			RETURN .F.
		ENDIF 
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE filtrargrilla
		local cFechaHasta, cFechaDesde, cFechaHastaVto, cFechaDesdeVto
		
		cFechaDesde = dtoc(ThisForm.tg_TxbFechaDesde.value)
		
		if empty( ThisForm.tg_TxbFechaHasta.value)
			cFechaHasta = dtoc(oapp.TomarMaximaFecha())
		else
			cFechaHasta  =  dtoc(ThisForm.tg_TxbFechaHasta.value)
		endif
		
		cFechaDesdeVto = dtoc(ThisForm.tg_txbFechaVtoDesde.value)
		
		if empty( ThisForm.tg_TxbFechaVtoHasta.value)
			cFechaHastaVto = dtoc(oapp.TomarMaximaFecha())
		else
			cFechaHastaVto =  dtoc(ThisForm.tg_TxbFechaVtoHasta.value)
		endif
		
		cFiltro = "BETWEEN(fecha,ctod('"+cFechaDesde+"'),  ctod('"+cFechaHasta+"'))" + "and BETWEEN(Fecha_Vto,ctod('"+cFechaDesdeVto +"'),  ctod('"+cFechaHastaVto +"'))"
		thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Desfiltrar()
		Thisform.oViewComPenClientes.filtrar(cFiltro)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		LPARAMETERS cId_Cliente,lSuma,dFecha,cId_Comproba,cId_GrupoSucur,cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,nReferencia
		DODEFAULT()
		
		thisform.AddObject("oClientes","Tg_tabla","Clientes","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblVnt_Docu","Tg_tabla","Vnt_Docu","CLAVE")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewComPenClientes","tg_viewComPenClientesCobranza")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewCreditoaFavor","tg_viewCreditoaFavorCliente")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros","Tg_Tabla","Parametros")
		thisform.AddObject("oConvMonUniversal","tg_ConvMonUniversal")
		
		Thisform.Id_Cliente = cId_Cliente
		Thisform.Id_Sucursal = cId_Sucursal
		Thisform.Id_Sistema = cId_Sistema
		Thisform.Id_Comproba = cId_Comproba
		Thisform.Nro_referencia = nReferencia
		
		IF TYPE("cId_GrupoSucur") <> "L"
			Thisform.Id_Gruposucur = cId_GrupoSucur
		ELSE 
			Thisform.Id_Gruposucur = ""
		ENDIF 
		
		Thisform.Suma = lSuma
		Thisform.Fecha = dFecha
		
		Thisform.Tg_Clientes1.Value = cId_Cliente
		
		IF Thisform.oClientes.Buscar(cId_Cliente)
			Thisform.RazonSocial.Value = Thisform.oClientes.Leer("Razon_Social")
		ENDIF 
		
		ThisForm.tg_txbFechaVtoDesde.value	= ctod("  /  /    ")
		ThisForm.tg_TxbFechaVtoHasta.value	= ctod("  /  /    ")
		ThisForm.tg_TxbFechaDesde.value 	= ctod("  /  /    ")
		ThisForm.tg_TxbFechaHasta.value		= ctod("  /  /    ")
		thisform.Tg_TxbGravado.value  		= 0.00
		thisform.Tg_TxbIva.value      		= 0.00
		thisform.Tg_TxbTotal.value    		= 0.00
		
		For mmpp=1 to thisform.tg_grid1.ColumnCount
			thisform.tg_Grid1.Columns(mmpp).DynamicBackColor="Iif(Thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer('lSeleccion'),rgb(128,128,192),rgb(255,255,255))"
			thisform.tg_Grid1.Columns(mmpp).DynamicForeColor="Iif(Thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer('lSeleccion'),rgb(255,255,255),rgb(0,0,0))"
		ENDFOR 
		
		*Thisform.Id_clienteanterior = cId_Cliente
		Thisform.Cancelado = .F.
		Thisform.IngresoImputacion = .F.
		Thisform.Imputado = .F.
		&&Thisform.tg_cmdAceptar.Enabled = .F.
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.ReadOnly=.t.
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column7.ReadOnly = .F.
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column8.ReadOnly = .F.
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column11.ReadOnly = .F.
		
		Thisform.Tg_CmdActualizar.Enabled = .F.
		Thisform.RefrescarConsulta(cId_Cliente,lSuma,dFecha,cId_Comproba,,0,0,0,Thisform.Id_Gruposucur)
		*cId_Cliente,lSuma,dFecha,cId_Comproba,vVec_CompImputacion,nTotalImputado,nImp_Iva,nImp_Gravado,cId_GrupoSucur
		Thisform.RefrescarConsultaCredito(cId_Cliente,!lSuma,Thisform.Id_Gruposucur)
		
		IF Thisform.oViewCreditoaFavor.Leer("Total") <> 0
			Thisform.Abrirformimputacion()
		ENDIF 
		
		 
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		Local cTexto,oLst
		
		If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<> "O"		 
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsultaComprobante",thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)				
			thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()
		Else
			Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)			
			thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()
		Endif	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE rearmarconsulta
		lParameters nTotalImputado,vVec_CompImputacion,dfecha,nImp_Iva,nImp_Gravado
		local nPos,vGrabacion,cId_Mon_deuda
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		nPos= 0
		thisform.oViewComPenClientes.IrPrimero
		cId_mon_deuda=thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("Id_Mon_Deuda")
		If type("vVec_CompImputacion[1,15]")<>"L"
			Do while !thisform.oViewComPenClientes.EsEof()
		           
			   for i= 1 to alen(vVec_CompImputacion,1)
			       if vVec_CompImputacion[i,15]=thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("Id_Sucursal")+thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("Id_Sistema")+thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("Id_Comproba")+STR(thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),10)    
		
			      	=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Imp_Pendiente", thisform.vVec_CompImputacion[i,8] )
			      	=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"lseleccion"   , .t.    )    				
			    	  thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)	
		       
		    	   endif
			   endfor
		 
			   thisform.oViewComPenClientes.IrSiguiente
			Enddo
		Endif	
		
		*thisform.GravadoAntMonedaPrincipal=Round(thisform.oConvMonUniversal.Convertir(nImp_Gravado, cId_Mon_Deuda, 0, thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("id_monedaPrincipal"), 0, dFecha, @vAuxiliar),2)
		*thisform.IvaAntMonedaPrincipal=Round(thisform.oConvMonUniversal.Convertir(nImp_Iva, cId_Mon_Deuda, 0, thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("id_monedaPrincipal"), 0, dFecha, @vAuxiliar),2)
		
		thisform.Tg_TxbGravado.value=   nImp_Gravado
		thisform.Tg_TxbIva.value=       nImp_Iva
		thisform.Tg_TxbTotal.value=     nTotalImputado
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		LPARAMETERS cId_Cliente,lSuma,dFecha,cId_Comproba,vVec_CompImputacion,nTotalImputado,nImp_Iva,nImp_Gravado,cId_GrupoSucur
		LOCAL nGrupoImputacion,dFechaDesde,dFechaHasta,cId_Cliente,lSuma,cId_Comproba
		
		IF TYPE("cId_GrupoSucur") <> "L"
			Thisform.Id_Gruposucur = cId_GrupoSucur
		ELSE 
			Thisform.Id_Gruposucur = ""
		ENDIF 
		
		IF Thisform.Cancelado
			thisform.Tg_TxbTotal.value = 0.00
			Thisform.Cancelado = .F.
		ENDIF 
		
		
		dFechaDesde = Thisform.tg_txbFechaDesde.Value
		dFechaHasta = Thisform.tg_txbFechaHasta.Value
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource= "" 
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		Thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Refrescar(cId_Cliente,lSuma,Thisform.Id_Gruposucur)
		
		Thisform.oTblVnt_Docu.Buscar(cId_Comproba, .F., "CLAVE")
		nGrupoImputacion = Thisform.oTblVnt_Docu.Leer("GrupoImputacion")
		
		Thisform.oViewComPenClientes.irprimero()
		Do While !Thisform.oViewComPenClientes.EsEof()
		
			If nGrupoImputacion <> Thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("GrupoImputacion")
				Thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Borrar()
			Endif
		
			Thisform.oViewComPenClientes.IrSiguiente()
		ENDDO	
		
		Thisform.Tg_Clientes1.Value = cId_Cliente
		
		IF Thisform.oClientes.Buscar(cId_Cliente)
			Thisform.RazonSocial.Value = Thisform.oClientes.Leer("Razon_Social")
		ENDIF
		
		IF nTotalImputado <> 0
			if type("thisform.vec_compimputacion[1,1]")="C"	
		
			   for i = 1 to alen(Thisform.vec_compimputacion,1)
			   		Thisform.oViewComPenClientes.FijarTag("Clave")
			   		
			   		IF Thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Buscar(Thisform.vec_compimputacion[i,15])
			   		
			   			Thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Borrar()
			   		
				       =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Sucursal",substr(Thisform.vec_compimputacion[i,1],1,3))    				
				       =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Sistema","V")    				
				       =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Comproba",Thisform.vec_compimputacion[i,3])    				
				       =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nro_Referencia",Thisform.vec_compimputacion[i,4])    				
				       =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Total",Thisform.vec_compimputacion[i,9])    				
				       =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Pendiente",.t.)  
				       =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Importe",Thisform.vec_compimputacion[i,9])    				  				
				       =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nro_Externo",Thisform.vec_compimputacion[i,10])    				
				       =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Fecha",Thisform.vec_compimputacion[i,11])  
				       =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Suma",iif(lSuma,.f.,.t.))
				   	   =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Cliente",cId_Cliente)    							  				
				   	   =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Imp_Pendiente",Thisform.vec_compimputacion[i,8])    				  				
				       =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"lSeleccion",Thisform.vec_compimputacion[i,5])
				       =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"PorcAPagar",0.00)
				       =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Fecha_Vto",Thisform.vec_compimputacion[i,6])
				       thisform.oViewComPenClientes.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
				     ENDIF 
			   ENDFOR 
			ENDIF
		ENDIF 
		
		Thisform.id_Clienteanterior = cId_Cliente
		
		
		
		*****
		*!*	if type("thisform.vec_compimputacion[1,1]")="C"	
		
		*!*	   for i = 1 to alen(Thisform.vec_compimputacion,1)
		*!*	   		Thisform.oViewComPenClientes.FijarTag("Clave")
		*!*	   		
		*!*	   		IF Thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Buscar(Thisform.vec_compimputacion[i,15])
		*!*	   		
		*!*	   			Thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Borrar()
		*!*	   		
		*!*		       =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Sucursal",substr(Thisform.vec_compimputacion[i,1],1,3))    				
		*!*		       =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Sistema","V")    				
		*!*		       =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Comproba",Thisform.vec_compimputacion[i,3])    				
		*!*		       =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nro_Referencia",Thisform.vec_compimputacion[i,4])    				
		*!*		       =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Total",Thisform.vec_compimputacion[i,9])    				
		*!*		       =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Pendiente",.t.)  
		*!*		       =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Importe",Thisform.vec_compimputacion[i,9])    				  				
		*!*		       =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nro_Externo",Thisform.vec_compimputacion[i,10])    				
		*!*		       =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Fecha",Thisform.vec_compimputacion[i,11])  
		*!*		       =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Suma",iif(lSuma,.f.,.t.))
		*!*		   	   =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Cliente",cId_Cliente)    							  				
		*!*		   	   =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Imp_Pendiente",Thisform.vec_compimputacion[i,8])    				  				
		*!*		       =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"lSeleccion",Thisform.vec_compimputacion[i,5])
		*!*		       =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"PorcAPagar",0.00)
		*!*		       =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Fecha_Vto",Thisform.vec_compimputacion[i,6])
		*!*		       thisform.oViewComPenClientes.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
		*!*		     ENDIF 
		*!*	   ENDFOR 
		*!*	ELSE 
		*!*		Thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Refrescar(cId_Cliente,lSuma)
		*!*		
		
		*!*		Thisform.oTblVnt_Docu.Buscar(cId_Comproba, .F., "CLAVE")
		*!*		nGrupoImputacion = Thisform.oTblVnt_Docu.Leer("GrupoImputacion")
		
		*!*		Thisform.oViewComPenClientes.irprimero()
		*!*		Do While !Thisform.oViewComPenClientes.EsEof()
		
		*!*			If nGrupoImputacion <> Thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("GrupoImputacion")
		*!*				Thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Borrar()
		*!*			Endif
		
		*!*			Thisform.oViewComPenClientes.IrSiguiente()
		*!*		ENDDO
		*!*	ENDIF
		
		*****
		
		Thisform.oViewComPenClientes.irprimero
		Thisform.RefrescarGrilla()
		
		*****
		*!*	if type("nTotalImputado")= "N"
		*!*	   if nTotalImputado <> 0
		*!*	      	thisform.RearmarConsulta(nTotalImputado,@vVec_CompImputacion,dfecha,nImp_Iva,nImp_Gravado)
		*!*	   ENDIF 
		*!*	ENDIF
		*****
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsultacredito
		LPARAMETERS cId_Cliente,lSuma,cId_gruposucur
		
		Thisform.oViewCreditoaFavor.Refrescar(cId_Cliente,lSuma,cId_gruposucur)
		
		Thisform.tg_txbCredito.Value = Thisform.oViewCreditoaFavor.Leer("Total")
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource= "" 
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		thisform.oViewComPenClientes.IrPrimero()
		Thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=	thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Alias
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource =  thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Alias+".Id_Sucursal"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource	=  thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Alias+".Id_Sistema"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource	=  thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Alias+".Id_Comproba"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource	=  thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Alias+".Nro_Referencia"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource	=  thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Alias+".Nro_Externo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource	=  thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Alias+".Importe"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource	=  thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Alias+".Imp_Pendiente"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource	=  thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Alias+".lSeleccion"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column9.ControlSource	=  thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Alias+".Fecha"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column10.ControlSource=  thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Alias+".Fecha_Vto" 
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column11.ControlSource=  thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Alias+".PorcAPagar" 
		                                                                                                      
		ThisForm.LockScreen=.t.	
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		                 
		thisform.oViewComPenClientes.irPrimero()
		             
		ThisForm.LockScreen=.f.	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE seleccionarcomprobante
		lParameters lValor, nSuma
		local vGrabacion, nCant_Pend
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		nCant_Pend= 0
		
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Imp_Pendiente",iif(lValor,thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("Importe"),nCant_Pend))  
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"PorcAPagar",iif(lValor,100,0))  				
		   
		thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)	
		
		*thisform.Tg_CmdAceptar.enabled=   .f.
		
		thisform.ValidarImportes(.f.)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE tildarcomprobantes
		local vGrabacion
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		thisform.oViewComPenClientes.irPrimero()
		
		do while !thisform.oViewComPenClientes.esEof()
		
			if !empty(thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("Importe"))
			   =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"lseleccion", thisFORM.lTodos )    				
			   thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)	
		
			   thisform.SeleccionarComprobante(thisFORM.lTodos)
		
			endif    
			
			thisform.oViewComPenClientes.irSiguiente()
		enddo
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE validarimportes
		lParameter lvalida
		local lResul, cMensaje,nImporte_Parcial,nImporte_ParcialMonedaPrincipal,vAuxiliar,cId_mon_deuda
		
		Dimension vAuxiliar[1]
		lResul= .t.
		cMensaje= ""
		nImporte_Parcial= 0
		nImporte_ParcialMonedaPrincipal=0
		
		if !thisform.oViewComPenClientes.EsEof()
		   nRegistro= thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Recno()
		else 
		   nRegistro= 1
		endif   
		
		thisform.oViewComPenClientes.IrPrimero
		*!*	cId_Mon_deuda=thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("id_mon_deuda")
		*!*	If Empty(cId_Mon_Deuda)
		*!*	   cId_Mon_Deuda=thisform.id_Mon_deudaProveedor
		*!*	Endif   
		if thisform.Tg_TxbGravado.value >= 0 and thisform.Tg_TxbIva.value >= 0
		
		   Do while !thisform.oViewComPenClientes.EsEof() and lResul
		
		      if thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("lSeleccion")
		         if (thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("Imp_Pendiente") > 0) .and. (thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("Importe") >= thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("Imp_Pendiente"))
		         	
		            nImporte_Parcial=nImporte_Parcial+ thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("Imp_Pendiente")
					*nImporte_ParcialMonedaPrincipal=nImporte_ParcialMonedaPrincipal+Round(thisform.oConvMonUniversal.ConvtotalComprobante(thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.,thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("id_monedaPrincipal"),thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("Imp_Pendiente"),thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("Id_mon_Deuda")),2)            
		         ELSE
		            cMensaje= "El importe a imputar de los comprobantes debe ser mayor a Cero, o "+chr(13)+;
		                      "el importe pendiente debe ser mayor o igual a el importe a imputar"
		            lResul= .f.        
		         endif   
		      endif
		   
		      thisform.oViewComPenClientes.IrSiguiente
		   Enddo
		
		else
		   cMensaje= "El Importe Gravado e Importe Iva debe ser Mayor o Igual a Cero"
		   lResul= .f.
		endif
		
		thisform.oViewComPenClientes.IrRegistro(nRegistro)
		
		*!*	acopy(thisform.vCotizaciones,vAuxiliar )
		
		*!*	thisform.GravadoAntMonedaPrincipal=Round(thisform.oConvMonUniversal.Convertir(thisform.Tg_TxbGravado.value, cId_Mon_Deuda, 0, thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("id_monedaPrincipal"), 0, thisform.Fecha_pago, @vAuxiliar),2)
		*!*	thisform.IvaAntMonedaPrincipal=Round(thisform.oConvMonUniversal.Convertir(thisform.Tg_TxbIva.value, cId_Mon_Deuda, 0, thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("id_monedaPrincipal"), 0, thisform.Fecha_pago, @vAuxiliar),2)
		
		
		thisform.Tg_TxbTotal.value= nImporte_Parcial+thisform.Tg_TxbGravado.value+thisform.Tg_TxbIva.value 
		
		*thisform.TotalMonedaPrincipal=nImporte_ParcialMonedaPrincipal +thisform.GravadoAntMonedaPrincipal + thisform.IvaAntMonedaPrincipal
		
		if !lResul and lvalida
		   =fMensAceptar(cMensaje)
		endif
		
		Return lResul
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE tg_btnFiltrar.Click
		thisform.FiltrarGrilla()
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE tg_btnTodos.Click
		IF !thisform.lTodos
			thisform.lTodos=.T.
		ELSE
			thisform.lTodos = .F.
		ENDIF
		
		IF This.Caption ="Desmarcar todos"
			This.Caption ="Marcar todos"
		ELSE
			This.Caption ="Desmarcar todos"
		ENDIF
		
		thisform.TildarComprobantes()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmdAceptar.Click
		*thisform.lCancelar_RetAuto= .f.
		
		*!*	IF Thisform.Ingresoimputacion
		*!*		=fMensAceptar("Se actualizará la información de la grilla porque ingresó a la ventana de imputación.")
		*!*		Thisform.RefrescarConsulta(Thisform.Id_Cliente,Thisform.Suma,Thisform.Fecha,Thisform.Id_Comproba,,0,0,0,Thisform.id_gruposucur)
		*!*		Thisform.RefrescarConsultacredito(Thisform.Id_Cliente,!Thisform.Suma,Thisform.id_gruposucur)
		*!*		Thisform.Ingresoimputacion = .F.
		*!*	ELSE 
			IF Thisform.Completarvector()
				thisform.Hide
				Thisform.Imputado = .F.
			ENDIF 
		*!*	ENDIF 
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmdActualizar.Click
		
		Thisform.RefrescarConsulta(Thisform.Id_Cliente,Thisform.Suma,Thisform.Fecha,Thisform.Id_Comproba,,0,0,0,Thisform.id_gruposucur)
		Thisform.RefrescarConsultacredito(Thisform.Id_Cliente,!Thisform.Suma,Thisform.id_gruposucur)
		
		Thisform.Ingresoimputacion = .F.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmdCancelar.Click
		*!*	IF Thisform.Imputado
		*!*		=fMensAceptar("Ud. entró a la ventana de imputación, por lo que no podrá cancelar esta operación y tendrá que aceptar para actualizar la consulta.")
		*!*	ELSE 
			Thisform.Cancelado = .T.
			thisform.Hide
		*!* ENDIF 
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmdImputaciones.Click
		IF Thisform.oTblVnt_Docu.Buscar(Thisform.Id_Comproba)
			nCopias = Thisform.oTblVnt_Docu.Leer("Copias")
		ENDIF 
		
		thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmImputarCliente","TG_Imputacion",Thisform.Id_Cliente,Thisform.Id_sucursal,Thisform.Id_Sistema,Thisform.ID_comproba,Thisform.Nro_Referencia,nCopias,thisform.Id_grupoSucur,.T.)
		thisform.oFrmImputarCliente.WindowType = 1
		
		Thisform.IngresoImputacion = .T.
		Thisform.Imputado = .T.
		
		thisform.oFrmImputarCliente.Show()
		
		Thisform.RefrescarConsulta(Thisform.Id_Cliente,Thisform.Suma,Thisform.Fecha,Thisform.Id_Comproba,,0,0,0,Thisform.id_gruposucur)
		Thisform.RefrescarConsultacredito(Thisform.Id_Cliente,!Thisform.Suma,Thisform.id_gruposucur)
		
		Thisform.Tg_CmdActualizar.Enabled = .T.
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column7.Text1.LostFocus
		local vGrabacion
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		
		*!*	if thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("Importe")<>0
		*!*	   =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"lseleccion", .t. )    				
		*!*	   thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)	
		*!*	endif
		
		IF This.Value <> 0
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"lseleccion", .t. )    				
		    thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
			thisform.ValidarImportes(.f.)   
		ENDIF 
		
		*thisform.Tg_CmdAceptar.enabled=   .f.
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column8.oChkSeleccionar.InteractiveChange
		local vGrabacion, lHayCheck, nRegistro
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		if !empty(thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Leer("Importe"))
		   =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"lseleccion", this.value )    				
		   thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)	
		
		   thisform.SeleccionarComprobante(this.value)
		else
		   this.value= .f.
		endif    
		
		if !thisform.oViewComPenClientes.EsEof()
		   nRegistro= thisform.oViewComPenClientes.Recno()
		else 
		   nRegistro= 1
		endif
		
		thisform.oViewComPenClientes.irPrimero()
		do while !thisform.oViewComPenClientes.esEof() 
			IF thisform.oViewComPenClientes.leer("lseleccion") 
				lHayCheck = .t.
			endif
		
			thisform.oViewComPenClientes.irSiguiente()
		ENDDO
		
		IF lHayCheck 
			ThisForm.tg_btnTodos.Caption ="Desmarcar todos"
		ELSE
			ThisForm.tg_btnTodos.Caption ="marcar todos"
		endif
		
		thisform.lTodos = lHayCheck 
		
		thisform.oViewComPenClientes.IrRegistro(nRegistro)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE tg_txbCredito.LostFocus
		thisform.ValidarImportes( .f. )
		
		*thisform.Tg_CmdAceptar.enabled=   .f.
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_txbGravado.LostFocus

	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_txbIva.LostFocus

		*thisform.Tg_CmdAceptar.enabled=   .f.
		
	ENDPROC

		this.value = substr( alltrim( this.value ) ,2, 29 )
		
		if len( alltrim( this.value ) )		= 29
		
			thisform.oTxbBanco.value 		= substr( alltrim( this.value ) ,  1,  3 )
			thisform.oTxbSucBanco.value 	= substr( alltrim( this.value ) ,  4,  3 )
			thisform.oTxbCodPos.value 		= substr( alltrim( this.value ) ,  7,  4 )
			thisform.oTxbNumero.value 		= substr( alltrim( this.value ) , 11,  8 )
			thisform.oTxbNumeroCuenta.value = substr( alltrim( this.value ) , 19, 11 )
		
			thisform.oTxbBanco.refresh()
			thisform.oTxbSucBanco.refresh()
			thisform.oTxbCodPos.refresh()
			thisform.oTxbNumero.refresh()
			thisform.oTxbNumeroCuenta.refresh()
		
			thisform.Tg_btnaceptar2.enabled = .t.
		
		else
		
		*	thisform.Tg_btnaceptar2.enabled = .f.
		
		endif
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE escobranza
		******* Martin
		LParameters cId_Comproba
		If Type("Thisform.oTblVnt_Docu") <> T_OBJECT
			Thisform.AddObject("oTblVnt_Docu","Tg_Tabla","Vnt_Docu","Clave")
		Endif
		ThisForm.oTblVnt_Docu.Buscar(cID_Comproba,.f.,"Clave")
		Return ThisForm.oTblVnt_Docu.Leer("Cobranza")
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE espago
		******* Martin
		LParameters cId_Comproba
		If Type("Thisform.oTblCmp_Docu") <> T_OBJECT
			Thisform.AddObject("oTblCmp_Docu","Tg_Tabla","Cmp_Docu","Clave")
		Endif
		ThisForm.oTblCmp_Docu.Buscar(cID_Comproba,.f.,"Clave")
		Return ThisForm.oTblCmp_Docu.Leer("Pago")
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		lParameters cId_Sucursal,cId_Valor,nOrden
		
		thisform.AddObject("oCaj_Valores","tg_Tabla","Caj_Valores","Clave")
		thisform.oCaj_Valores.Buscar(cId_valor)
		thisform.name=alltrim(thisform.Name)+cId_valor
		doDefault()
		
		thisform.AddObject("oView_CajMovValores","tg_ViewCajMovValores")
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oView_CajMovValores.Alias
		
		thisform.Refrescar(cId_Sucursal,cId_Valor,nOrden)
		thisform.Tg_Grid1.ResaltarRenglon
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		Local cTexto,oLst,cId_Sistema
		cId_Sistema	= Thisform.oView_CAjMovValores.Leer("Id_Sistema")
		Do Case 
		 Case cId_Sistema = oApp.CodSistema("VENTAS")
			  ****** Martin
			  If ThisForm.EsCobranza(thisform.oView_CAjMovValores.Leer("TG_Id_Comproba"))
			 		If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza")<>T_OBJECT			 
						thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza","TG_ConsultaCobranza",thisform.oView_CAjMovValores.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),cId_sistema,thisform.oView_CAjMovValores.Leer("TG_Id_Comproba"),thisform.oView_CAjMovValores.Leer("TG_Nro_Referencia"),.t.)				
					Else
						Thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza.ConsultarCobranza(thisform.oView_CAjMovValores.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),cId_sistema,thisform.oView_CAjMovValores.Leer("TG_Id_Comproba"),thisform.oView_CAjMovValores.Leer("TG_Nro_Referencia"),.t.)			
					Endif	
					thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza.Show()
				Else	  
			  	If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
						thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsultaComprobante",thisform.oView_CAjMovValores.Leer("TG_Id_Comproba"),thisform.oView_CAjMovValores.Leer("TG_Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oView_CAjMovValores.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),cId_sistema,.t.)				
						thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()
					Else
						Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oView_CAjMovValores.Leer("TG_Id_Comproba"),thisform.oView_CAjMovValores.Leer("TG_Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oView_CAjMovValores.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),cId_sistema,.t.)			
					Endif	
					***** Nuevo
					thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()
				Endif
		
		  Case cId_Sistema = oApp.CodSistema("COMPRAS")	
				******* Martin
				If ThisForm.EsPago(thisform.oView_CAjMovValores.Leer("TG_Id_Comproba"))	
					If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaPago")<>T_OBJECT			 
						thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaPago","TG_ConsultaPago",thisform.oView_CAjMovValores.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),CId_sistema,thisform.oView_CAjMovValores.Leer("TG_Id_Comproba"),thisform.oView_CAjMovValores.Leer("TG_Nro_Referencia"),.t.)				
					Else
						Thisform.oFrmConsultaPago.ConsultarPago(thisform.oView_CAjMovValores.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),CId_sistema,thisform.oView_CAjMovValores.Leer("TG_Id_Comproba"),thisform.oView_CAjMovValores.Leer("TG_Nro_Referencia"),.t.)			
					Endif	
					******* Nuevo
					thisform.oFrmConsultaPago.Show()
				Else	
					If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCompras")<>T_OBJECT			 
						thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCompras","TG_ConsCompCompras",thisform.oView_CAjMovValores.Leer("TG_Id_Comproba"),thisform.oView_CAjMovValores.Leer("TG_Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oView_CAjMovValores.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),cId_sistema,.t.)				
						thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCompras.Show()
					Else
						Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCompras.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oView_CAjMovValores.Leer("TG_Id_Comproba"),thisform.oView_CAjMovValores.Leer("TG_Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oView_CAjMovValores.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),cId_sistema,.t.)			
					Endif	
					thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCompras.Show()
				Endif	
				  	
		  Case cId_Sistema = oApp.CodSistema("VENDEDORES")
				If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaVendedores")<>T_OBJECT			 
					thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaVendedores","TG_ConsCompVendedores",thisform.oView_CAjMovValores.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),cId_Sistema,thisform.oView_CAjMovValores.Leer("TG_Id_Comproba"),thisform.oView_CAjMovValores.Leer("TG_Nro_Referencia"),.t.)				
				Else
					Thisform.oFrmConsultaVendedores.ConsultarCompVendedores(thisform.oView_CAjMovValores.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),cId_sistema,thisform.oView_CAjMovValores.Leer("TG_Id_Comproba"),thisform.oView_CAjMovValores.Leer("TG_Nro_Referencia"),.t.)			
				Endif	
				thisform.oFrmConsultaVendedores.Show()
		  
		  Case cId_Sistema = oApp.CodSistema("COBRADORES")
				If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaCobradores")<>T_OBJECT			 
					thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaCobradores","TG_ConsCompCobradores",thisform.oView_CAjMovValores.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),CId_Sistema,thisform.oView_CAjMovValores.Leer("Tg_Id_Comproba"),thisform.oView_CAjMovValores.Leer("TG_Nro_Referencia"),.t.)				
				Else
					Thisform.oFrmConsultaCobradores.ConsultarCompCobradores(thisform.oView_CAjMovValores.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),CId_sistema,thisform.oView_CAjMovValores.Leer("TG_Id_Comproba"),thisform.oView_CAjMovValores.Leer("TG_Nro_Referencia"),.t.)			
				Endif	
				thisform.oFrmConsultaCobradores.Show()
		  
			Case cId_Sistema = oApp.CodSistema("CAJA")	
				If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaCaja")<>T_OBJECT			 
					thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaCaja","TG_ConsCompCaja",thisform.oView_CAjMovValores.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),cId_Sistema,thisform.oView_CAjMovValores.Leer("Tg_Id_Comproba"),thisform.oView_CAjMovValores.Leer("Tg_Nro_Referencia"),.t.)				
				Else
					Thisform.oFrmConsultaCaja.ConsultarCompCaja(thisform.oView_CAjMovValores.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),cId_sistema,thisform.oView_CAjMovValores.Leer("TG_Id_Comproba"),thisform.oView_CAjMovValores.Leer("Tg_Nro_Referencia"),.t.)			
				Endif	
				Thisform.oFrmConsultaCaja.Show
				
		  Case cId_Sistema = oApp.CodSistema("BANCO")
				If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaBancos")<>T_OBJECT			 
					thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaBancos","TG_ConsCompBanco",thisform.oView_CAjMovValores.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),cId_Sistema,thisform.oView_CAjMovValores.Leer("Tg_Id_Comproba"),thisform.oView_CAjMovValores.Leer("Tg_Nro_Referencia"),.t.)				
				Else
					Thisform.oFrmConsultaBancos.ConsultarCompBanco(thisform.oView_CAjMovValores.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),cId_sistema,thisform.oView_CAjMovValores.Leer("TG_Id_Comproba"),thisform.oView_CAjMovValores.Leer("TG_Nro_Referencia"),.t.)			
				Endif	
				thisform.oFrmConsultaBancos.Show()
		
		  
		EndCase		
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescar
		lParameters cId_Sucursal,cId_Valor,nOrden
		
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta(cId_Sucursal,cId_Valor,nOrden)
		ThisForm.cId_Sucursal	=	cId_Sucursal
		ThisForm.cId_Valor		=	cId_Valor
		ThisForm.nOrden				=	nOrden
		thisform.tg_Label2.Caption=thisform.oView_CAjMovValores.Leer("Valor")
		thisform.tg_Label4.Caption=thisform.oView_CAjMovValores.Leer("Sucursal")
		thisform.tg_Label6.Caption=Alltrim(str(thisform.oView_CAjMovValores.Leer("Orden")))
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.Refrescar(ThisForm.cId_Sucursal,ThisForm.cId_Valor,ThisForm.nOrden)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		lParameters cId_Sucursal,cId_Valor,nOrden
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.oView_CajMovValores.Refrescar(cId_Sucursal,cId_Valor,nOrden)
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oView_CajMovValores.Alias
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oView_CajMovValores.Alias+".Fecha"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oView_CajMovValores.Alias+".Comprobante"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oView_CajMovValores.Alias+".NombreSistema"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oView_CajMovValores.Alias+".Detalle"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oView_CajMovValores.Alias+".Estado"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=thisform.oView_CajMovValores.Alias+".Caja"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource=thisform.oView_CajMovValores.Alias+".Tenedor"
		
	ENDPROC

	ENDPROC

	ENDPROC

		lparameter cId_Cuenta, Cid_Chequera, nNro_minimo, nNro_maximo
		local i
		
		thisform.Tg_cmbNrosLibres.RowSourceType = 0
		
		FOR i = nNro_minimo tO nNro_maximo
			if !thisform.oCaj_ChequesPropios.Buscar(cId_Cuenta+ Cid_Chequera + str(i,20),.F., "nro_chec2")
				thisForm.Tg_cmbNrosLibres.additem(str(i))

		endfor
		
		i = nNro_minimo
		 
		thisForm.Tg_cmbNrosLibres.value=str(i)

DEFINE CLASS tg_prorrateoobrassociales AS tg_custom OF "tg_clasesbasicas.vcx" 
 	*< CLASSDATA: Baseclass="custom" Timestamp="" Scale="Pixels" Uniqueid="" />

	*<DefinedPropArrayMethod>
		*m: grabar
		*m: grabarcabecera
		*m: grabarcaja
		*m: grabarcobranza
		*m: grabarcomision
		*m: grabarcomprobanteajustemandataria
		*m: grabarcomprobanteajusteobrasocial
		*m: grabarcomprobantereciboobrasocial
		*m: grabarcotizaciones
		*m: grabarimputacion
		*m: grabarivas
		*m: grabarlogliquidacion
		*m: grabarrelacioncomprobantes
		*m: grabarrelacionimputaciones
		*m: grabarrelacionimputacionmandataria
		*m: grabarsubasiento

		*p: id_sistemaajuste
		*p: id_sucursalajuste

		*p: nrovalor
		*p: nro_externoajuste
		*p: nro_referenciaajuste
		*p: numeracionrecibo
	*</DefinedPropArrayMethod>

	*<PropValue>
		idclientemandataria = .F.
		id_comprobaajuste = .F.
		id_sistemaajuste = .F.
		id_sucursalajuste = .F.
		Name = "tg_prorrateoobrassociales"
		nro_referenciaajuste = .F.
	*</PropValue>
	
	PROCEDURE grabar
		lParameters oTblLiquidaciones, oTblComprobantesAjuste, cId_ClienteMandataria, cId_Comproba, cId_Sistema, nNro_Referencia, cId_Sucursal, dFecha
		
		This.FechaCmp = dFecha
		This.IdClienteMandataria = cId_ClienteMandataria
		
		If This.ProcesoDeControl()
		
			This.GrabarComprobanteAjusteMandataria(oTblComprobantesAjuste, cId_ClienteMandataria)
		
			This.GrabarComprobanteReciboObraSocial(oTblLiquidaciones)
			
			This.GrabarComprobanteAjusteObraSocial(oTblComprobantesAjuste, oTblLiquidaciones)
		
			This.GrabarRelacionComprobantes(oTblLiquidaciones, oTblComprobantesAjuste, cId_Comproba, cId_Sistema, nNro_Referencia, cId_Sucursal) 	
			    
			This.GrabarRelacionImputaciones(oTblLiquidaciones, oTblComprobantesAjuste)
		
			This.GrabarRelacionImputacionMandataria(oTblLiquidaciones, oTblComprobantesAjuste, cId_Comproba, cId_Sistema, nNro_Referencia, cId_Sucursal)
			
			This.GrabarLogLiquidacion(oTblLiquidaciones, cId_Sucursal, cId_Sistema, cId_Comproba, nNro_Referencia)
		
		Endif
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE grabarcabecera
		lParameters cId_Sucursal, cId_Sistema, cId_Comproba, nNro_Referencia, nTotal, cId_Cliente, nNro_Externo, cLeyenda1

		This.oTblClientes.Buscar(cId_Cliente , .F., "CLAVE")
		
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Comproba"		, cId_Comproba)
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Sistema"		, cId_Sistema)

		&&=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Fecha"			, Date()) && ANTES 17/02/2016 This.FechaCmp)
